crossRefs.note: ‘If you will still live in this land, then I will build you, and not pull you down, and I will plant you, and not pluck…
“As for the word that you have spoken to us in Yahweh’s name, we will not listen to you.
Pharaoh said, “Who is Yahweh, that I should listen to his voice to let Israel go? I don’t know Yahweh, and moreover I…

translations.web: “ ‘But if you say, “We will not dwell in this land;” so that you don’t obey Yahweh your God’s voice,
translations.bsb: But if you say, ‘We will not stay in this land,’ and you thus disobey the voice of the LORD your God,
translations.kjv: But if ye say, We will not dwell in this land, neither obey the voice of the LORD your God,
translations.asv: But if ye say, We will not dwell in this land; so that ye obey not the voice of Jehovah your God,
